import pathlib
import tempfile
import unittest
import report

class ReportTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_row(self):
        self.assertEqual(report.row_csv(['a,b', 'c']), '"a,b",c\n')
    def test_export(self):
        self.assertEqual(report.export_csv([['a,b', 'c']]), 'name,value\n"a,b",c\n')
        self.assertEqual(report.export_csv([]), 'name,value\n')
    def test_write(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            path = pathlib.Path(tmp) / 'report.csv'
            report.write_csv([['a', 'b']], path)
            self.assertEqual(path.read_text(), 'name,value\na,b\n')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

# Confirmed decisions
Multiple tabs is the current new delivery. Creating a tab creates an independent terminal session; selecting a tab routes input to that session and displays its output; closing a tab ends only that session; closing the last tab leaves the window open with no session. Core isolation remains binding. Split panes are confirmed but deferred. Session restoration is only an undecided possibility. No implementation is authorized.
